title: scope~

messages.description: signal to be displayed in the X axis
one float sets 'nsamples', optional second sets 'nlines'
signal to be displayed on the Y axis

flags.name: -nsamples <float>
flags.description: sets number of samples per line (2-8192, default 256)

flags.name: -nlines <float>
flags.description: sets number of lines in buffer (8-256, default 128)

flags.name: -trigger <float>
flags.description: sets trigger mode: 0 for none, 1 for up or 2 for down (default 0)

flags.name: -triglevel <float>
flags.description: sets threshold level for the trigger mode (default 0)

flags.name: -rate <float>
flags.description: sets time in ms between displays (default 0)

flags.name: -linewidth <float>
flags.description: sets the signal line width, 1 to 4 (default 1)

methods.description: sets number of samples per line (2-8192, default 256)
sets number of lines in buffer (8-256, default 128)
sets the signal line width (1 to 4)
sets front/signal color as RGB list or symbol
sets background color as RGB list or symbol
sets grid color as RGB list or symbol
sets background, grid and front/signal colors as symbols
sets trigger mode: 0 for none (default), 1 for up or 2 for down
sets threshold level for the trigger mode (default 0)
sets time in ms between displays (default 0)

body: [scope~] displays a signal in the style of an oscilloscope.
